title: Sun 15 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] Quiet Sunday — Carney says US trade talks are 'making progress' (no deal), Houthis take the area near the Bab el-Mandeb strait (oil risk at the open), no central-bank news. All 29 reads unchanged.
[b]Tomorrow:[/b] Japan Q3 GDP 01:50 Bucharest · China data 04:00 · Swiss GDP 10:00 · Canada CPI 15:30 · Warsh 19:00.

EUR.note: Senate passed the PLFSS revenue part 200–110 (13 Nov, before the PHASE 1 cutoff; M note); spread test (<~137bp) not met.

GBP.note: No new BoE item; UK jobs Tue 09:00 and CPI Wed 09:00 Bucharest.

JPY.note: No new MoF/BoJ comment since Katayama's 13 Nov warning; Q3 GDP Mon 01:50 Bucharest.

CHF.note: No SNB item; Swiss Q3 GDP flash Mon 10:00 Bucharest.

CAD.note: Carney: talks 'making progress', no deal, tariffs unchanged; Bab el-Mandeb news may lift oil (information only); CPI Mon 15:30.

AUD.note: No RBA or Australian item; China activity data Mon 04:00 Bucharest.

NZD.note: No new vote tally or RBNZ item; GDT auction Tue 14:00 Bucharest.

XAU.note: Gold factor −3 unchanged; no ETF/central-bank data; Yemen strait headline is context only.

pairs.hook: Sunday was quiet, but the French Senate had quietly done the euro a small favour.
pairs.note:
[b]📍 DAILY CHECK · Sun 15 Nov (evening)[/b]

[b]Sunday was quiet, but the French Senate had quietly done the euro a small favour.[/b]
Late on Friday the Senate approved the revenue half of France's social-security budget, 200 votes to 110. That is a smoother step than feared, yet the spread test in our plot twist (back under ~137bp) is not met, and bond markets were shut all weekend. Across the Atlantic, no Fed voice rewrote the December script. Gap stays −8.
